row: Iron Gait Percherons, Inc. - Draft Horse Rescue & Sanctuary

We want to try to save as many of these massive horses as we physically can by going to auctions and purchasing & saving them from slaughter, owner surrenders as well as helping authority seizures across the USA. We refurbish all their medical, emotional & nutritional needs and find them safe, loving forever homes. Many people are not aware of how wonderful a Percheron performs as a riding companion, through our Rescue we hope to inform the public & community of this simple & rewarding new job for these gentle giants.
